title: Michol
summary: Raleigh names Michol in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Michol, Daughter of Saul, giuen to Phalti from Dauid. No yeere of the World was taken for her. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
